items.name: Readability
items.evidence: This is essentially the reference fix. It adds one line with a short comment, '# Ensure base table is in the query', in the existing style. The added test has a clear name: test_fast_delete_all.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It calls the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper inside single_alias. There is no duplicated logic and nothing left over from debugging. The added regression test follows the existing FastDeleteTests patterns.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is a minimal idempotent call with no new error paths and no magic constants. It fixes the underlying alias-counting bug instead of special-casing .all().

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias via self.query.get_initial_alias(), so the MySQL compiler override gets the fix too. Joined deletes still use the subquery. The hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).
